name: Delete contact
description: Call this when the user wants a contact permanently removed from the whole Brevo account, not just taken off one mailing list. If the goal is only to stop sending to a contact while keeping their record and history, use contacts.update_contact to set them to blocklisted instead, and if the goal is to take them off a specific list or add them to another, use contacts.bulk_modify_list. Resolve the numeric contact id first (for example via the contact index or contacts.get_preview) because this action identifies the contact by internal id, not by email.
preconditions: The contact must already exist and be identified by its internal numeric id.
The session must be authenticated against the web app backend on contacts-api.brevo.com (cookie/session based, not an API key).

id.description: Internal numeric id of the contact to delete, taken from the URL path (observed value: 3). This is the web app's contact id, not the contact's email address.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation of the deletion, e.g. "Contact has been successfully deleted".

side_effects: The contact record is removed from the account.
The contact disappears from every list and segment it belonged to.
Subsequent lookups of this contact id fail.

evidence: playwright trace (local, not committed; reproduce with "pnpm verify"): test-results\contacts.delete_contact.trace.zip
